It is a large (2MB) JSONL transcript. DO NOT read it whole. Use targeted `jq`, `grep`, `sed` via Bash. Each line is a JSON object with .type ("user"/"assistant"), .message.content (array of blocks with .type "text"/"tool_use"/"tool_result").

Useful recipes:
- All user messages (the human's instructions — MOST IMPORTANT):
  jq -r 'select(.type=="user") | (.message.content // empty) | if type=="string" then . else (.[] | select(.type=="text") | .text) end' FILE | head -200
- Assistant text replies (to see report FORMAT):
  jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="text") | .text' FILE | head -300
- Tool names used / frequency:
  jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use") | .name' FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
- Subagent prompts (to see delegation style):
  jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use" and .name=="Agent") | .input.prompt' FILE | head -50

Answer these questions with CONCRETE EVIDENCE (short quotes, max 20 words each):
1. REPORT FORMAT: how did the assistant format its answers to the user? (bullet counts, word limits, tables, headers, language RU/EN, emoji/ticks, verdict lines). Quote 2-3 examples verbatim.
2. AGENCY / PERMISSION MODEL: did the assistant act autonomously or ask before acting? Any explicit user instructions about "safe mode", asking permission, "не спрашивай", "спрашивай", plan mode, board/доска? Quote them.
3. DELEGATION: how were subagents used — how many, which models (haiku/sonnet/opus), what kind of tasks, how were their prompts structured?
4. HANDOFF PROTOCOL: any mention of handoff / хендофф / session extract / "rule 35" / fresh agent writing handoff. Quote exactly what was said and any file paths written.
5. WORKFLOW RITUALS: recurring steps — verification before claiming done, evidence requirements, logs, checkpoints, "доска"/board, TODO tracking, file naming conventions for reports.

Also: list the exact file paths of any handoff/report/checkpoint documents the session WROTE (grep tool_use Write/Edit file_path values):
  jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use" and (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit")) | .input.file_path' FILE | sort -u

Return a structured plain-text report, max 900 words, organized under the 5 headings + the file list. Be concrete, quote-heavy, no speculation.

Чинить `SKILL.md` нужно прямо в отдельном репозитории — правки там ничем не перезатрутся.

4.
